scope: Check whether mapped XChat GTK2 windows expose exact 15x15 matches to the active normal stepper assets, without displaying, OCRing, or retaining conversation pixels.

observed.method: XWD pixels streamed through ImageMagick and checked in memory for exact RGB matches to each active DomainOS normal stepper asset; no image file was retained by this scan.

result: The pixel scan did not find a full exact 15x15 match in the scanned XChat windows. This is inconclusive: the actual scrollbar cell was not isolated, and the live process may have stale resources, a different state, or a capture/composition difference. It does not prove arrow geometry, color, or which GTK theme is currently rendered.

privacy_and_changes.handling_incident: A preliminary xwd command used '-out -', which created a 1.6 MB full-window dump named './-' in the repository. It was not opened or analyzed and was immediately removed; no retained copy remains. Subsequent scans streamed through memory without files.

next: Do not infer current XChat styling from this scan. A precise scrollbar-only capture is needed, or an explicitly coordinated XChat restart/reopen to load the updated GTK2 resources. Preserve active chat sessions.
